title: 365 lbs (160 kg) Nippard shrugs for 15
summary: I got these snatch grip schrugs from Jeff Nippard's channel and therefore named them after him. I break at the knee to increase the stretch on the traps. You can do these with your knees locked and obtain the same result by leaning forward more but it will result in thoracic rounding. Careful if you have never used a wide grip for schrugs before, the stretch on the back and biceps is much stronger than with a regular grip.
